instrumentation_positive_control: Require an actual forward call on TorchSeqRecognizer.nn.nn for all 61 intact rows. Abort interpretation and exit nonzero if this control fails.
prior_attempt: Run 40511667932 executed all conditions and replayed 27 development predictions, but its hook was attached to the unused enclosing container. Its zero-call and preprocessing-short-circuit fields are invalid and must not be interpreted. The rerun changes only instrumentation and adds this positive control; model, inputs, conditions, seeds, scoring and permutation groups remain fixed.
permutation_groups: Within role and folio, sort by image width/height then row id; split at floor(n/2). Permute reference indices within each half. Same draws for all conditions.
permutation_statistic: Micro edit-error count; diagnostic lower-tail fraction (1 + permuted counts <= observed)/(B + 1). Conditional exchangeability is an assumption, not guaranteed by these annotations.
selection: No retraining, parameter search, threshold search or checkpoint selection. Model selected from the already explored previous development experiment.
scope: Provisional references on previously explored leaves 3/4. Mechanistic pipeline diagnostic, not a confirmatory test, decipherment or proof of linguistic meaning.
white_control: Count actual Torch network forward calls for every row. An empty output with zero network calls is a preprocessing short circuit, not evidence about the network's blank-image behavior.
failures: Retain each row failure. Do not replace failed rows by empty predictions for scoring. Incomplete conditions have no pooled score.
